title: Recall
description: One retrieval core over many user-controlled sources, with honest coverage when a source cannot answer.
provenance: Authored 2026-09-14 from inspected Recall source (internal/*, pkg/*, cmd/*, docs/*). Current elements cite supporting evidence paths; the trust-tier signal is planned per docs/plans/active/okf-trust-tier.md.

boundaries.title: Thin transports
boundaries.description: The CLI, HTTP API, MCP server, and Sidecar plugin parse, render, and report. No ranking, permission, or expansion behavior lives here.

boundaries.title: Trust assigned at the boundary
boundaries.description: Profiles set the sensitivity ceiling and eligibility rules. Adapters cannot mark text trusted or lower a floor.

boundaries.title: Out-of-process adapters
boundaries.description: External adapters run as supervised subprocesses speaking newline-delimited JSON-RPC behind the same adapter contract.

scenes.title: Recall at a glance
scenes.description: Thin surfaces over one retrieval core, built-in and external adapters over sources Recall reads but never owns.

scenes.title: From question to evidence
scenes.description: Follow a query from a surface through eligibility planning, rank fusion, and locator expansion.

scenes.title: Where trust is decided
scenes.description: Profiles, ceilings, and eligibility: why a source is asked, skipped, or reported instead of silently dropped.

scenes.title: Reported trust tiers
scenes.description: A planned documents signal: derive each document's review tier from frontmatter so profiles can prefer human-reviewed writing.
